name: Pop
description: A pop song: verses that build through pre-choruses into choruses, then a bridge and a final double chorus. 72 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Set the mood with a hint of the chorus's melody or chords, then get out of the way.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: Tell the story over a lighter groove, so the chorus has somewhere to lift to.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.tip: Build toward the chorus: rising chords or melody, and fewer drums just before it hits.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The hook: the fullest part, with the catchiest melody, repeated.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: New words over the same chords. Add a part or two so it doesn't sound like a repeat.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.tip: Build up again, a little bigger than the first time.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The hook again, with a new layer: harmonies, a counter-melody or more drums.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.tip: Change something: new chords, a breakdown or another rhythm, so the last chorus feels fresh.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The final chorus, often twice through: the biggest moment of the song.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Wind down: end on the hook, fade out, or take the parts out one by one.
